summary: Payments product leader with hands-on experience at Starling Bank and Revolut, turning customer and market insight into measurable outcomes: a 34% cut in settlement failures on Faster Payments and an 18% reduction in chargeback disputes through a redesigned claims flow reaching 2.1 million customers. Deep domain fluency in the payments products this role would market, grounded in data-driven decision making.

bullets: Owned the Faster Payments integration, cutting settlement failures by 34%
Led a team of 6 engineers and 2 designers
Built payments features and led hiring for the team
Reduced chargeback disputes by 18% by redesigning the claims flow
Launched card controls used by 2.1 million customers
